name: MvPolynomial.taylor_monomial
source:
theorem taylor_monomial (α : σ → R) (k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    taylor α (monomial k a) = C a * k.prod fun j n ↦ (X j + C (α j)) ^ n :=
  aeval_monomial _ _ _
